title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - Animal
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/Animal. An individual and identifiable living organism that feeds on organic matter, typically having specialized sense organs and nervous system and able to respond rapidly to stimuli. Subclass of saref:FeatureOfInterest (SAREF core class, not modeled here); animals and animal groups are related to measurements via the saref:FeatureOfInterest concept of SAREF. Animals can be further specialized using subclasses, e.g. a lactating cow created as a subclass of Animal (ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.2.4/4.3.1 example, not part of the base ontology). NOTE: dataModel.Agrifood (the official Smart Data Models AgriFood subject) already publishes its own distinct entity also named 'Animal'; naming is kept verbatim from the ontology per translation rules, so this is a known name collision to resolve during Candidates review.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Animal'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. rdfs:label (max 1 per the ttl restriction). The name of the animal.

identifier.description: Property. saref:hasIdentifier (max 1, xsd:string, inherited from SAREF core). The unique identifier of the animal (e.g. ear tag number).

taxonRank.description: Property. obo:TAXRANK_1000000 ('has taxon rank') some obo:TAXRANK_0000000 ('Taxon rank'), reusing the OBO TAXRANK taxonomy vocabulary. The taxonomic classification of the animal, e.g. 'Bos taurus' (see the ex:Cow1/ex:Cow2 TAXRANK example in ETSI TS 103 410-6 clause 4.3.1, Figure 7).

dateOfBirth.description: Property. s4agri:hasBirthDate (max 1, xsd:dateTime). The birth date of the animal.

dateOfDeath.description: Property. s4agri:hasDeathDate (max 1, xsd:dateTime). The death date of the animal, if applicable.

isLocatedIn.description: Relationship. s4agri:isLocatedIn some geo:Feature (inverse: s4agri:isLocationOf). The physical location (e.g. a Parcel) of the animal.

isMemberOf.description: Relationship. s4agri:isMemberOf some AnimalGroup (inverse: s4agri:hasMember). The AnimalGroup this animal is a member of.
